clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country to buy an apple orchard in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark and distance growing between them, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over their father's land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir as her anxiety eased and she began to function again by September 1953.

clusters.name: The orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968 when a late frost took the crop and the bank called in the loan, within the following year: Walter drinking heavily most nights, conflict between Walter and Glen over blame for the loan, Glen and Marian overfunctioning to take over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worsening that winter, you wetting the bed again in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May 1969, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning other men's trees by October 1969.

clusters.name: Glen losing his job at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the following year: Glen out of work most of that year sitting in the truck in the yard, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night while Glen was away, you stopped eating properly and lost weight that summer, you kept to your room and said little to your mother, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and you eating again and making the track team by June 1976.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into your house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Hollis's mother Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house in January 1990, within the following year: clashes between you and Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals, you and Hollis drawing apart as he kept out of the kitchen rows and took his mother's side, Owen having tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, your eczema flaring on both hands, rows with Hollis most nights, your mother driving over twice a week to take your side, Wilma taking a flat in town in June 1991, and your eczema clearing over the summer.

clusters.name: The wildfire, August 1994
clusters.reason: A real threat came over the ridge in August 1994 when a wildfire forced the family out; within four days from the evacuation to returning home: you were frightened and kept the children in sight every minute, Lily sick to her stomach in the school gym, conflict between you and Hollis over whether to drive out of the valley, Owen would not sleep without a light on, the house was untouched when you were allowed home, and you and the children were calm again once home and back at school that week; an acute episode around a real and immediate threat, settled within days once the threat passed.
